title: A ball launched at 20 m/s, 45° up

steps.say: With no air resistance the ball follows a parabola, y = x − 0.0245 x², from launch to landing.
Halfway, at 20.4 m, it reaches its maximum height: v² sin²45° / 2g = 400 × 0.5 / 19.6 = 10.2 m.
It lands 40.8 m away: the range is v² sin 90° / g = 400 / 9.8 = 40.8 m.
